title: API authorisation, validation and state-dependent updates

story.summary: Promotions API: update a promotion's name
story.description:
As an integrator I want to rename promotions through the API with proper authorisation and validation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- PATCH /api/promotions/{id} requires the role promotion_editor; callers without it receive HTTP 403 and the promotion is unchanged.
- Unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 401.
- The field name is required and must be 3 to 80 characters long; violations return HTTP 422 with the field name in the error body.
- Only promotions in Draft or Scheduled status can be updated; updating an Active or Ended promotion returns HTTP 409.
- A request for a promotion id that does not exist returns HTTP 404.
